title: PACT Protocol — Mandate Lifecycle Demo
description: 60-second terminal demo: create, sign, and verify an agent mandate using @godman-protocols/pact

scenes.caption: PACT: The missing coordination layer for AI agents
Agents need clear authority to act. PACT mandates define it.

scenes.text: node -e "const p=require('@godman-protocols/pact'); const m=p.createMandate({issuer:'agent-ceo',scope:'invoice:write',constraints:{maxAmount:1000},ttlMs:3600000}); console.log('Mandate:', m.id); console.log('Hash:', m.hash.slice(0,16)+'...');"

scenes.caption: Each mandate gets a cryptographic hash for tamper detection
Signatories bind themselves to the mandate terms

scenes.text: node -e "const p=require('@godman-protocols/pact'); const m=p.createMandate({issuer:'agent-ceo',scope:'invoice:write',constraints:{maxAmount:1000},ttlMs:3600000}); const signed=p.signMandate(m,'agent-cfo'); console.log('Signatures:', signed.signatures.length); console.log('Signatories:', signed.signatures.map(s=>s.signerId).join(', '));"

scenes.caption: Multi-signature support for m-of-n trust requirements
Any agent can verify: scope + expiry + signatures

scenes.text: node -e "const p=require('@godman-protocols/pact'); const m=p.createMandate({issuer:'agent-ceo',scope:'invoice:write',constraints:{maxAmount:1000},ttlMs:3600000}); const v=p.verifyMandate(m); console.log('Valid:', v.valid); console.log('Scope:', v.scope); console.log('Expires in:', Math.round(v.remainingMs/1000)+'s');"

Valid: true
Scope: invoice:write
Expires in: 3599s
scenes.caption: Zero-trust verification — no shared state required
